definition: Population registered in Sweden at the end of 1899. Published single ages 0–89 and 90 or older. The year-end stock is used for the following opening midnight.
uncertainty: National historical official series. Ages from 90 onward are grouped. The source publishes no sampling error or unknown-age count.
opening_method: Use the SCB national age and sex stock for the year ending immediately before the opening midnight.

definition: Population registered in Sweden at the end of 1900. Published single ages 0–89 and 90 or older.
uncertainty: National historical official series. Ages from 90 onward are grouped. The source publishes no sampling error or unknown-age count.

definition: Population of Norway at the start of 1900. Published single ages 0–104 and 105 or older.
uncertainty: Official age and sex estimate from decennial censuses, births, deaths and available migration counts. SSB does not publish an error interval.
opening_method: Use the SSB national estimated age and sex counts at the opening date.

definition: Population of Norway at the start of 1901. Published single ages 0–104 and 105 or older.
uncertainty: National historical official series. The 1900 census was at the end of the year. SSB does not publish an error interval.
